content: Reality is merely an illusion, albeit a very persistent one.
author: Albert Einstein
story:
At its core, this reflection cuts through our everyday excuses. Living in pretense takes an enormous amount of mental energy. When you constantly manage impressions to please others, you end up feeling like an imposter in your own skin.

Albert Einstein understood that real peace is never won by escaping the world or blaming external circumstances. Honesty with yourself can feel uncomfortable at first, but it is the only ground upon which a real life can be built. When you stop lying to yourself about your feelings, your energy is immediately freed up.
reflectionPrompt: What would change in your daily outlook if you truly lived by this perspective?
